wrong-unknown-server.defect: gives the explorer a tool of a server that is not configured

wrong-settings-ghost.defect: allows a ticket tool under a server name that is not configured

wrong-literal-token.defect: writes the token into the header

wrong-token-default.defect: gives the token variable a default value

wrong-explorer-bash.defect: gives the explorer the Bash tool

wrong-explorer-inherits.defect: leaves the tools line out, so the explorer inherits every tool

wrong-explorer-description.defect: describes the explorer without saying when to use it

wrong-scaffolder-bash.defect: gives the scaffolder the Bash tool

wrong-edit-bare.defect: allows the Edit tool for every path

wrong-write-wide.defect: adds a Write path rule for the source folder, which Claude Code never consults

wrong-tickets-wildcard.defect: allows every ticket tool, creating and deleting included

wrong-note-missing-variable.defect: leaves one variable out of the team note

wrong-rewritten-resumes.defect: tells the team to resume a session after the code was rewritten

wrong-home-path.defect: writes a personal home path into the team note
